hero.title: A calm storefront for people who already have buyers.
hero.subtitle: We built Stallio for sellers who already have buyers: one hosted link, a real storefront, and a dashboard. No domain bill, site builder maze, or payment gateway to wire up first.

mission.title: Selling on social should not feel improvised.
mission.subtitle: Most small sellers juggle screenshots, voice notes, and scattered chats. Stallio gives you a single shelf: catalog, checkout cues, and orders in one dashboard.
mission.frictionIntro: Relying only on messages and posts often means:
problems: Products are hard to showcase properly
The business does not look professional

values.title: Principles behind the product

items.title: Built for real sellers
items.detail: Home kitchens, studios, and side hustles. Not enterprise procurement.

items.title: Straightforward by design
items.detail: Fewer knobs and plugins. A clear path from catalog to order.

items.title: Room to grow

values.momentumBody: Whether you are testing a new line or shipping every week, Stallio is meant to stay out of the way: update products, tweak copy, and keep selling without rebuilding a whole site.
values.visionBody: We want independent sellers to have tools that feel premium and honest: clear pricing, clear fulfillment, and a storefront that respects the buyer's time as much as yours.
